item.title: Active Directory Basics
item.description: Introduction # If you work in IT or cybersecurity, you are going to encounter Active Directory. It is the backbone of almost every corporate network. Trying to learn it by reading disconnected documentation can be frustrating because every concept seems to rely on three other concepts you have not learned yet.
